task: broad 12-label Indian banking grievance routing (not fine-grained ATM classification)
labels: DEPOSIT-SB/ CA/TERM DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS-Dispute in charges deducted
DEPOSIT-SB/ CA/TERM DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS-Minimum Balance Charges related
DIGITAL BANKING-ATM RELATED-Dispute in ATM AMC Charges
DIGITAL BANKING-FUND REMITTANCE: NEFT/ RTGS/ IMPS through Branch-Dispute in charges deducted
LOANS & ADVANCES-Education Loans-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
LOANS & ADVANCES-Govt Scheme loans-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
LOANS & ADVANCES-Home loans-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
LOANS & ADVANCES-OTHER ADVANCES-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
LOANS & ADVANCES-Personal loans-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
LOANS & ADVANCES-SME ADVANCES-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
LOANS & ADVANCES-VEHICLE LOANS-Discrepancy in Charges (Processing Fee/Documentation charges, Inspection charges, etc)
calibration: sigmoid CalibratedClassifierCV, cv=3, fitted only on train+validation split
critical_limitations: The dataset contains templated/synthetic-looking text; provenance does not establish real customer representativeness.
Exact duplicate and conflicting-label leakage is addressed, but near-duplicate template leakage may remain.
Test metrics estimate performance on this dataset distribution only; do not claim them as real Indian customer or ATM failure accuracy.
This model's 12 broad complaint labels must not replace the 77-label BANKING77 model or the future fine-grained ATM model.
